'''Greystar Holdings''' was a warehouse located in the recycling district of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that was used as a safe-house by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
